# SintBot

> Connect your project group to Claude Code or Codex. Use Claude, GPT, or GLM, MiniMax and DeepSeek through Claude Code; keep project files and shared notes on your own machine.

Generated from https://sintbot.com/ by scripts/build-zh.mjs — the same facts as the page.

## FAQ

### What is SintBot?

A coding assistant that connects a project group to Claude Code or Codex on your own machine. You can choose the coding agent and its model service, while keeping the project files and saved notes. The current download has a narrower scope, described below.

### What does 1.3.0 support?

macOS, Node.js 22+, one Feishu group and Codex, running in the foreground. Multiple groups, other model routes, Slack, WeCom, whiteboards, the console, schedules and other operating systems are not included.

### Can I upgrade my existing installation?

Keep your previous version if you depend on capabilities outside this release. Installing a separate package does not migrate existing state; wait for a compatible migration procedure.

### Does everything work offline?

No. SintBot and the project run on your machine, but the chat platform and configured model services require a network connection. Model requests follow the selected agent’s configuration and the service provider’s data policy.

### What do I need to install it?

A Mac with Node.js 22+, an installed and signed-in Codex, and a Feishu application configured according to the versioned guide. Use Feishu China edition; international Lark is not supported.

### How is SintBot licensed?

SintBot is distributed under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0. The package includes its built-in core, the license and third-party notices. Model service access is configured separately.

### Which models can SintBot use?

Existing multi-model installations use Claude through Claude Code, GPT through Codex, and GLM, MiniMax or DeepSeek through Claude Code with compatible endpoints and your own API keys. Kimi and other compatible providers can use custom endpoints. The 1.3.0 download currently includes only the Codex route.

### What stays when I switch models?

The project files and saved shared notes remain. Switching starts a fresh conversation; record decisions and unfinished work in the project so the next agent can read them. It does not automatically transfer every unsaved detail from the previous conversation.

## 中文

> 把项目群接入 Claude Code 或 Codex，可选 Claude、GPT，也可通过 Claude Code 接入 GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek 等模型。项目文件与共享记忆保留在自己的机器上。

## 常见问题

### SintBot 是什么？

把项目群连接到自己机器上的 Claude Code 或 Codex 的编码助手。你可以选择编码执行器及其模型服务，保留项目文件和已保存的笔记。当前下载版本的范围较窄，具体见下方版本说明。

### 1.3.0 支持哪些使用方式？

macOS、Node.js 22 及以上、一个飞书群与 Codex，使用时在前台运行。多群、其他模型通道、Slack、企业微信、画板、控制台、定时与其他操作系统不包含在本版中。

### 现有安装能直接升级吗？

依赖本版范围之外的能力时，请保留原版本。单独安装程序不会迁移已有状态，请等待兼容的迁移方案。

### 全部处理都在离线环境完成吗？

不是。SintBot 和项目在本机运行，聊天平台及配置的模型服务仍需联网。模型请求遵循所选执行器的配置及服务商的数据政策。

### 安装需要准备什么？

一台已安装 Node.js 22 及以上的 Mac、已安装并登录的 Codex，以及按版本指南配置的飞书应用。使用飞书中国版，暂不支持国际版 Lark。

### SintBot 使用什么许可证？

SintBot 按 PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 分发。安装包包含内置核心、许可证与第三方声明，模型服务需要另行配置。

### SintBot 可以使用哪些模型？

已有的多模型版本可通过 Claude Code 使用 Claude，通过 Codex 使用 GPT，也可在 Claude Code 中配置兼容端点和自己的 API Key，接入 GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek。Kimi 等兼容服务可使用自定义端点。当前 1.3.0 下载包仅包含 Codex 路径。

### 换模型之后，什么会保留？

项目文件和已保存的共享笔记保留。切换会开启新对话；把决定和未完成事项写进项目，下一位助手即可读取接续，不会自动完整转移上一段对话中尚未保存的细节。
